subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Shareholder Lawsuits
description: A short lesson to help you apply Shareholder Lawsuits.

hook.text: The stock drops 40% after the CEO hid losses. Shareholders sue the board for failing to oversee management.

buildup.text: Derivative lawsuits let shareholders sue directors on behalf of the company for breach of fiduciary duty.

discovery.text: Securities class actions average over 200 filings per year in the US, seeking billions in damages.

twist.text: Most cases settle. D&O insurance pays. Directors rarely face personal financial consequences.

climax.text: Shareholder lawsuits are the last resort of governance. They punish after the fact but rarely prevent harm.

punchline.text: Sue the board. Settle. Insurance pays. Repeat next year.

quiz.question: What is a derivative lawsuit?
options: A shareholder suing directors on behalf of the company
A lawsuit filed by the board against shareholders
